verdict.rationale: Shopify documents natural-language operation: you ask your assistant something like "find me crewneck sweaters under $50" and the AI Toolkit skill picks the right UCP CLI command. The CLI and plugin install paths covering search, carts, checkout, handoff and orders are documented, and a hands-on probe confirms the underlying CLI works against live endpoints. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent corroboration of the natural-language-to-command translation itself, and explicit documentation that natural-language commands extend beyond catalog search to cart, checkout and order operations.
